question: Which chemical element from group 18 of the modern periodic table, whose atomic number is 10, contains a mixture of three stable isotopes commonly used to make signal and gas lasers and as a refrigerant?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Neon__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Neon belongs to the group of inert gases i.e. **Group 18.**
 
• Neon** atomic number is 10.**
 
• Neon was **discovered (1898)** by the British chemists** Sir William Ramsay and Morris W. Travers.**
 
• If a **current of electricity is run through it when it is under low pressure,** it will **emit a brilliant orange-red light.**
 
• It is a** colorless inert noble gas**.
 
• It is also the **second lightest noble gas.**
 
• Neon is **used in discharge tubes and fluorescent bulbs** for advertisement display purposes.
 
• Neon bulbs are** used in botanical gardens and in green houses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Group 18:**

 
• The elements present in **Group 18** have **their valence shell orbitals completely filled **and, therefore, react with a few elements only under certain conditions.

 
 
• Therefore, they are now known as** noble gases.**
 
 
 
• They have **ns2 np6 valence shell **electronic configuration** except 'Helium'** which has **1s2.**
 
• **All the gases except Rn occur in atmosphere.**
 
• **Rn is obtained as the decay product of 226Ra.**
 
• Group 18 consist of **6 elements**:
 
 
• **Helium (He), neon (Ne), argon (Ar), krypton (Kr), xenon (Xe) and radon (Rn).**
 
• All these are gases and **chemically unreactive.** 
 
• They **form very few compounds.** 
 
• Because of this they are **termed noble gases**.
